plain: The inventor Nikola Tesla said that in Colorado Springs, around 1899, he communicated with beings from beyond Earth. Michels mentions it several times himself without naming a source: "He said he spoke he communicated with aliens in Colorado Springs". Once he adds that Tesla said he "saw the past, present, and future all in one". A guest named Steve, on an episode about a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in human bodies, also says that "they talked to Tesla, too", and he points to Tesla's own writings as the source. Michels and Steve bring it up independently. If true, one of the great inventors would have been in contact with someone not human.
